note: Scratch instances and the composed-response specification consumed by tools/check_n22_components.js. The shipped registry (data/response_types.json, N22-A) is the authority for every contract; nothing here replaces a shipped contract. Instances marked N22B-SCRATCH are practice-fixture data, not bank questions.

fixture_question_reasons.Q03: The shipped Q03 registry field declares source instance.payload.template_options, and no bank instance carries it (see observations). The scratch instance adds the three authored template options so the radio group can be exercised.
fixture_question_reasons.Q11: Parity draws a two-point line with the scratch q11_two_point instance because the shipped Q11 instance has no capture context whose axes cover its y span (see observations).
fixture_question_reasons.Q17: The shipped Q17 instance has no payload.structure_parts, so the palette is absent there; the scratch q17_structure instance carries two structure parts so select-and-place can be exercised.

observations.observed: data/response_types.json Q03 declares fields[0].source = instance.payload.template_options (radio group) and fields[2].source = static (conserved), but no data/bank instance carries payload.template_options.
observations.component_behaviour: render(Q03, ...) throws E_INPUTS_CONTRACT_VIOLATION naming field "choice" instead of rendering an empty radio group.
observations.needed: N22-A: either declare the template options in the registry (a contract-level option_source) or add payload.template_options to the Q03 instances; N24 needs one of the two before the Q03 widget can be assembled.

observations.observed: No registry entry declares a capture context or figure for Q11/Q12, and the shipped N18 capture contexts (capture_contract.capture_contexts) have y_max <= 0,55 while the bank Q11 instance COL1-2-2D-A-01 has y values 0,30..0,74.
observations.component_behaviour: The capture context is supplied by the assembler through initialState(..., {capture_context_id}); without one the Q11 draw path fails with E_INPUTS_CONTRACT_VIOLATION naming draw_payload.
observations.needed: N22-A/N24: declare (or bind at assembly) a capture context whose evaluated axes cover the instance span.

observations.observed: Q12 figure_binding uses option_source sim-figures, so the select offers every figure in the island (45 options) for a single declared reading.
observations.component_behaviour: Options are named by each figure's title_key; the binding stays a required field (the A.1.2 corner case: a read with values but no binding is incomplete).
observations.needed: N22-A/N24: bind the field to the instance's own figure list rather than the whole island.

observations.observed: Q14 and Q18 option fields both use label_key input.selection.selected ("Izvēlētās atbildes"), so every checkbox in the group resolves to the same accessible name; Q07 has a per-option pattern (input.q07.option_cell with {option}).
observations.component_behaviour: Each checkbox is its own field with its own id (opt_<option_id>) and the option text in visible_label, but the aria_name is the group phrase repeated.
observations.needed: N22-A: give Q14/Q18 a per-option pattern (for example input.selection.option_cell with {option}); N33's live pass will otherwise hear four identically named checkboxes.

observations.observed: The term bank has response-level state phrases (input.state.complete/incomplete/invalid/pending_grading) and per-field missing messages (input.missing.*) but no per-field "filled" phrase.
observations.component_behaviour: A field's state_text is the completion missing message when empty, the Latvian error message when in error, the pending phrase while a self-assessed answer waits, and the stored text itself once filled. No colour-only state and no invented Latvian.
